# Latest signed test build

`HiFi-Player-audit.apk` is the newest signed build of the *audit* variant
(`com.aiproject.musicplayer.audit`, signed with the local audit test key).
It installs next to the main app and is meant for quick testing and handing out.
This folder always holds exactly one APK: the current one.

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | 0.18.0 (1800) |
| SHA-256 | `f25a3d34980c9c1172df165734e96732f1b96949cb37c61245ec9ea673b8514c` |

Install: `adb install -r dist/HiFi-Player-audit.apk`
